# NWS Risk and Operational Decision Assessment

## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together automated tools for NWS risk assessment and support of APHIS operational decision making. Registered work includes geostatistical modeling, cellular automata, data processing, dashboard pipelines, custom LLM, and a group NWS repository.

<article class="geoepi-subproject-card">
<h3>Cochliomyia Hominivorax Interpretation and Model Evaluation</h3>

CHIME is a gpt-oss-120b LLM for integrating New World screwworm (NWS) knowledge, interpreting model outputs, generating adversarial scenarios, and orchestrating computational experiments across linked models and HPC workflows.

</article>
